select distinct branch_id, branch_name,orgname ,sum(score_details) as score_details from ( select distinct branch_id, branch_name,orgname ,sum(score_details) as score_details from TBL_RISK_IMPROVEMENT_DETAILS d left join TBL_RISK_MONTHLY_EVALUATION e on e.id=d.IMPROVEMENT_ID left join tbl_organization o on o.orgid=e.unit_deptid where 1=1 and e.unit_deptid is not null
and branch_id=#{id}
and o.orgname LIKE concat(concat('%',#{orgname}),'%')
group by o.orgname,branch_name,branch_id union select distinct branch_id, branch_name,orgname ,sum(score_details) as score_details from TBL_RISK_IMPROVEMENT_DETAILS d left join tbl_risk r on r.riskid=d.riskid left join tbl_organization o on o.orgid=r.belongsto where 1=1
and branch_id=#{id}
and o.orgname LIKE concat(concat('%',#{orgname}),'%')
and d.improvement_id =0 group by o.orgname,branch_name,branch_id ) dual group by orgname,branch_name,branch_id

select distinct branch_name,branch_id,(select (sum(score_details)) from TBL_RISK_IMPROVEMENT_DETAILS r where r.branch_id=d.branch_id ) as score_details from TBL_RISK_IMPROVEMENT_DETAILS d where branch_id=#{id}
and branch_name LIKE concat(concat('%',#{orgname}),'%')

select * from ( select ls.*,nt.risknumber as risknumber,o.orgname from TBL_RISK_IMPROVEMENT_DETAILS ls left join tbl_risk nt on ls.riskid = nt.riskid left join TBL_RISK_MONTHLY_EVALUATION e on e.id=ls.IMPROVEMENT_ID left join tbl_organization o on o.orgid=e.unit_deptid where ls.BRANCH_ID=#{id} and e.unit_deptid is not null
and o.orgname LIKE concat(concat('%',#{orgname}),'%')
union all select ls.*,nt.risknumber as risknumber,o.orgname from TBL_RISK_IMPROVEMENT_DETAILS ls left join tbl_risk nt on ls.riskid = nt.riskid left join tbl_organization o on o.orgid=nt.belongsto where ls.BRANCH_ID=#{id} and ls.improvement_id=0
and o.orgname LIKE concat(concat('%',#{orgname}),'%')
) dual order by id desc
